scripts.typecheck: pnpm build && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && pnpm -r --sort --if-present typecheck
scripts.test: node --test scripts/release-integrity.test.mjs scripts/verify-release-stage.test.mjs scripts/verify-activation-contract.test.mjs scripts/verify-community-files.test.mjs scripts/verify-samples.test.mjs && pnpm -r --workspace-concurrency=1 --sort --if-present test
scripts.test:provider-compatibility: pnpm --filter "@loomrail/provider-codex..." --filter "@loomrail/provider-claude-code..." build && pnpm exec vitest run packages/provider-codex/test/diagnostics.unit.test.ts packages/provider-claude-code/test/diagnostics.unit.test.ts
scripts.test:project-verification: pnpm --filter "@loomrail/daemon..." build && pnpm --dir packages/contracts exec vitest run test/verification.unit.test.ts && pnpm --dir packages/domain exec vitest run test/verification-run.unit.test.ts && pnpm --dir packages/domain exec vitest run test/qa-correction.test.ts -t "delivery-wide|shared owner gate" && pnpm --dir packages/process-supervision exec vitest run test/process-tree.unit.test.ts test/supervised-process.integration.test.ts && pnpm --dir packages/project-readiness exec vitest run test/verification-scanner.integration.test.ts test/verification-publisher.integration.test.ts test/verification-runner.integration.test.ts && pnpm --dir packages/persistence-sqlite exec vitest run test/verification-run-state.integration.test.ts && pnpm --dir packages/persistence-sqlite exec vitest run test/local-state.integration.test.ts -t "next shared position|mixed-evaluator QA gate" && pnpm --dir apps/daemon exec vitest run --project unit test/project-verification-gate.unit.test.ts && pnpm --dir apps/daemon exec vitest run --project unit test/verification-output-retention.unit.test.ts && pnpm --dir apps/daemon exec vitest run --project integration test/session-worker.integration.test.ts -t "drives a CODEX-shaped"
scripts.test:reporting: pnpm build && pnpm --dir packages/contracts exec vitest run test/reporting.unit.test.ts && pnpm --dir packages/domain exec vitest run test/reporting.unit.test.ts && pnpm --dir packages/persistence-sqlite exec vitest run test/local-state.integration.test.ts -t "privacy-safe reporting facts" && pnpm --dir apps/daemon exec vitest run test/reporting.unit.test.ts test/server.integration.test.ts -t "reporting runtime categories|privacy-safe local Insights|bounded crash preview" --maxWorkers=1 && pnpm --dir apps/web exec vitest run src/reportDownload.test.ts
scripts.test:public-readiness: node scripts/check-public-tree.mjs && node scripts/check-toolchain.mjs && node scripts/verify-activation-contract.mjs
scripts.verify: pnpm format:check && pnpm test:public-readiness && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
